issue: सत्य धर्म मद लोभ न गाजे: the half has no verb for सत्य धर्म; read as 'before truth and dharma, pride and greed cannot roar'.
our reading: Before truth and dharma, pride and greed cannot roar.
alternatives: Truth and dharma (are in you); pride and greed do not roar (in you).

issue: धर मत्स्य तन सिन्धु बनाया: बनाया read as 'set in order'; the line joins the Fish avatar with the fourteen jewels of the churning.
our reading: Taking the body of a fish, you set the ocean in order, and had the fourteen jewels brought out.
alternatives: बनाया for मथाया (churned); 'made the ocean (your home)'.

issue: अमिलख: both witnesses print it; read as अमिय लखि, 'seeing the nectar'.
our reading: Seeing the nectar, the demons raised a quarrel.
alternatives: A corrupt word, perhaps अमित लख ('countless') or अमी लखि.

issue: हार पार शिव सकल बनाई: read as 'Śiva, having tried every means, was defeated'. (सती is settled as Śiva's consort, Pārvatī: in the Śiva Purāṇa Jalandhara goes to Pārvatī disguised as Śiva, and she then asks Viṣṇu to deceive Vṛndā in the same way, as the next verse has it, शिवरानी.)
our reading: Śiva tried every means and still was defeated; then the wicked one went and deceived Satī.
alternatives: हार पार as 'made all his arrangements (and fought it) through'.

issue: देखत तीन दनुज शैतानी: तीन read as 'three'; the story's demons are not named.
our reading: On seeing three wicked demons, Vṛndā came and clung to you.
alternatives: तीन for तिन, 'them' (on seeing those wicked demons).

issue: निगम: the Veda, or the poet's name (a signature in the last verse).
our reading: The Veda ever proclaims this prayer.
alternatives: Nigama (the poet) ever recites this prayer.
